definitions.gloss: rapidly; quickly; at a fast pace
definitions.explanation: Describes something happening or changing at a noticeably fast rate. Often used in news and academic writing about trends and developments.

examples.japanese: {人口|じんこう}が{急速|きゅうそく}に{増|ふ}えている。
{技術|ぎじゅつ}は{急速|きゅうそく}に{進歩|しんぽ}している。
{少子化|しょうしか}の{影響|えいきょう}で、{地方|ちほう}の{人口|じんこう}が{急速|きゅうそく}に{減少|げんしょう}している。
examples.english: Due to the declining birthrate, the population in rural areas is decreasing rapidly.

notes: Commonly appears in news articles and formal writing about societal changes, economic trends, and technological developments. Common collocations include {急速|きゅうそく}に{発展|はってん}する (to develop rapidly), {急速|きゅうそく}に{広|ひろ}まる (to spread rapidly), and {急速|きゅうそく}に{変化|へんか}する (to change rapidly). The base form {急速|きゅうそく} can also function as a な-adjective: {急速|きゅうそく}な{変化|へんか} (rapid change).
